gloss: to begin writing; to start writing

definitions.gloss: to begin writing; to start writing
definitions.explanation: To start the act of writing — a letter, essay, novel, or any text. A compound verb formed from {書|か}く and {始|はじ}める.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{始|はじ}めた。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高校生|こうこうせい}→高校生：01580_koukousei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: He started writing novels when he was in high school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日記|にっき}→日記：01486_nikki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{始|はじ}めて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しく→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Since I started writing a diary, every day has become more enjoyable.

notes:
A compound verb combining ⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write) + {始|はじ}める (to begin). Follows the standard V-stem + {始|はじ}める pattern used to express the beginning of an action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{始|はじ}める: to start writing a letter
- ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{始|はじ}める: to start writing a novel
- ⟦{日記|にっき}→日記：01486_nikki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{始|はじ}める: to start writing a diary
- ⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{始|はじ}める: to start writing a report

COMPOUND VERB PATTERN:
V-stem + {始|はじ}める is a productive pattern:
- ⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧{始|はじ}める: to start reading
- ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧{始|はじ}める: to start eating
- ⟦{走|はし}り→走る：00519_hashiru⟧{始|はじ}める: to start running

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{書|か}き{出|だ}す→書き出す：13053_kakidasu⟧: to begin writing — more spontaneous or sudden onset
- ⟦{執筆|しっぴつ}する→執筆する：25397_shippitsusuru⟧: to write (professionally) — formal, for authoring books/articles
